scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: sh -c 'export PORT="${PORT:-5000}" BASE_PATH="${BASE_PATH:-/}"; pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build && node scripts/stage-spa.mjs && next build && node scripts/migrate.mjs'
scripts.dev:hosted: sh -c 'export PORT="${PORT:-5000}" BASE_PATH="${BASE_PATH:-/}"; pnpm --filter @workspace/bookcase-community run build && node scripts/stage-spa.mjs && env -u DATABASE_URL next dev --webpack --port 3210'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
